title: Finite enriched horn-cell filtration for coherent simplex thickenings
statement: Use simplicial sets, simplices and horns of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the subset-poset simplicial categories $\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]$ of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. For any small simplicial set $K$, put $\mathfrak C[K]=\operatorname{colim}_{\Delta^r\to K}\mathfrak C[\Delta^r]$, with colimit in simplicial categories. For a simplicial set $X$, let $U(X)$ have two objects $a,b$, morphism simplicial sets $U(X)(a,b)=X$, $U(X)(b,a)=\varnothing$, and both endomorphism simplicial sets $\Delta^0$, with composition specified by identities. For $n\geq2$ and $0<i<n$, the induced enriched functor $\mathfrak C[\Lambda_i^n]\to\mathfrak C[\Delta^n]$ admits a finite filtration by pushouts in simplicial categories. Every successive attaching map is a finite coproduct of maps $U(\Lambda_j^m)\to U(\Delta^m)$ induced by horn inclusions, where $m\geq1$ and $0\leq j\leq m$; all stages have the object set $\{0,\ldots,n\}$ and the transition functors are the identity on objects.

source.place: Proposition 2.4.5.8 (00LR), the enriched inner-horn inclusion and its hollow-cube mapping object; Corollary 2.4.5.10 (00LT) for extension through that mapping object, and Corollary 2.4.5.12 (00LV) for the box inclusion. The finite free-horn filtration is the combinatorial triangulation refinement of this box calculation, stated here as an agent-specified support lemma. Read online 2026-10-17; archival copy WANTED.
